Not a W3C case. SPEC-24 acceptance 4 (HDB-51): `DELETE DATA` against a store
with a registered circuit rule withdraws the consequences. `rules.txt` names
the rules `w3c_update_suite.rs` registers on the `HornBackend` circuit before
the update; the derived rows live in `<https://horndb.io/graph/circuit-derived>`
and are compared like any other graph. HornBackend leg only.
